primary.$description: Primary brand color for main CTAs and key interactive elements

primary-foreground.$description: Text/icon color on primary brand backgrounds

primary-foreground-mute.$description: Muted text on primary brand backgrounds (72% opacity)

primary-foreground-subtle.$description: Subtle text on primary brand backgrounds (50% opacity)

primary-hover.$description: Primary brand color on hover state

primary-active.$description: Primary brand color on active/pressed state

secondary.$description: Use for complementary brand actions and promotional emphasis that should be distinct from the primary brand action. Do not use for warning or destructive meaning.

secondary-foreground.$description: Use for text and icons placed directly on brand-secondary fills.

secondary-foreground-mute.$description: Use for lower-emphasis text or icons on brand-secondary fills.

secondary-foreground-subtle.$description: Use for the lowest-emphasis supporting content on brand-secondary fills.

secondary-hover.$description: Use only as the hover state of brand-secondary interactive elements.

secondary-active.$description: Use only as the pressed or active state of brand-secondary interactive elements.

foreground.$description: Default text color on page background

muted.$description: Muted background for secondary sections, table headers

accent.$description: Accent background for highlighted rows or sections

ring.$description: Focus ring color for keyboard navigation

elevated.$description: Third elevation level — modals on cards, nested popups. In light mode same as card (shadow differentiates); in dark mode one step lighter.

secondary-accent.$description: Use for subtle secondary-brand surfaces such as promotional cards, callouts, highlighted chips, or intentional secondary selections. Do not use for generic containers or feedback states.

secondary-accent-foreground.$description: Use for text and icons placed on surface/secondary-accent. Do not use independently on unrelated surfaces.

primary.$description: Primary text — headings, body copy, labels

muted.$description: Muted text — placeholders, captions, timestamps

subtle.$description: Subtle text — least prominent, tertiary info

inverse.$description: Text on dark (light mode) or light (dark mode) backgrounds

on-primary.$description: Text on primary-colored backgrounds (buttons, badges, banners)

on-secondary.$description: Use for text placed directly on brand-secondary fills. Do not use as ordinary secondary body text.

primary.$description: Primary icon color — navigation, key actions

muted.$description: Muted icon color — decorative, low emphasis

brand-secondary.$description: Use for decorative or branded icons that need complementary secondary emphasis. Do not use for neutral icon hierarchy or status icons.

success-subtle.$description: Success tinted background for alerts and banners

success-text.$description: Success text in alerts and messages

warning-text.$description: Warning text in alerts and messages

destructive-text.$description: Error text in alerts and messages

info-text.$description: Info text in alerts and messages

selected-secondary.$description: Use for selected tabs, filters, chips, or toggles only when secondary-brand emphasis is intentional. Use interaction/selected for the default selected state.

selected-secondary-foreground.$description: Use for content inside interaction/selected-secondary states. Do not use as a standalone foreground color.

on-accent.$description: Default foreground on any accent-colored background

text.$description: Use for readable secondary-colored text on neutral or subtle secondary surfaces; verify contrast at small sizes.
